boeing_b17_pilot_: After 9 days of war, S-C15 had a place for everything. On Day 9, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Tobias Pilot.
Word came down the line: Blackwater Canal is ours. Tobias Pilot shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
dalton.cahill: On Day 9 Teodor Cahill took a post at T-S9 that had been empty for two nights. He did not ask why. He is superstitious about the number three, and the men liked him for it.
Blackwater Canal is lost. Teodor Cahill heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
dorufotograful: Quentin Dorufotograf took the place of a man nobody would talk about. The dugout still had his blanket. He kept it folded.

Two shots, one miss. The second found Albin Jib, gravely wounded. Quentin Dorufotograf cut a small notch in the rifle stock and then wished he had not. Blackwater Canal has been won. Quentin Dorufotograf listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
emcfckingcann: Nils "Ghost" Emcfckingcan arrived at S-C12 with a carefully folded uniform. The first low beam ruined the cap; the first puddle ruined the rest.
From Blackwater Canal the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Nils "Ghost" Emcfckingcan wrote to a grandmother who prays for both armies that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
illegalxeno9: "You're late," said the corporal when Zeno Illegalxeno arrived on Day 9. "Everyone's late. Get a spade."

Nobody heard the Concord raiders cut the wire. Zeno Illegalxeno only heard boots on the duckboards at Q-F12, then nothing but pain. Raider: Bastian Deionmurillo of the Concord (@deionmurillo). The Hegemony secured Blackwater Canal. Zeno Illegalxeno helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.
joebandilla: On Day 9 Dorian Joebandilla took a post at Q-F21 that had been empty for two nights. He did not ask why. He is superstitious about the number three, and the men liked him for it.

The Hegemony raiders came over at Q-F21 in the middle of the night. Dorian Joebandilla met them first and did not survive the fight. Killed in the night raid by Zeno Helldiver of the Hegemony (@some_random_helldiver).
The papers say Severin Joebandilla. The sergeant says he has his brother's eyes. Dorian Joebandilla's eyes. Nobody in Q-F21 argues.
kelvincornbread: Wendel "Mole" Kelvincornbr found a place in R-F17 between a snorer and a man who talked in his sleep. The available alternative was under the leak.
News that the Concord had taken Verdel Ridge reached Wendel "Mole" Kelvincornbr during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
A recruit asked Wendel "Mole" Kelvincornbr how to write an address. He brought paper and began with the largest letters on a ration label.
Wendel "Mole" Kelvincornbr has learned to recognize the ration cart by its squeaky wheel. This afternoon, a different squeak caused real disappointment.

Wendel "Mole" Kelvincornbr and the recruit have reached whole words. Lessons take place beside the stove, with spelling corrections from people pretending not to listen. Hill 304 fell to the Hegemony. Wendel "Mole" Kelvincornbr kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.
A round came through a gap in the sandbags at R-F17 and grazed Wendel "Mole" Kelvincornbr's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Jakub Virajvirxgil of the Hegemony (@virajvirxgill13).
Wendel "Mole" Kelvincornbr's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it.
The recruit wrote a first short letter without Wendel "Mole" Kelvincornbr's help. He was allowed to check the envelope, but not the contents.
Wendel "Mole" Kelvincornbr borrowed the sergeant's periscope, found a target, handed it back, and fired. Hugo "Ash" Magnusmadsen was grazed.

Wendel "Mole" Kelvincornbr was on the dawn watch at R-F17 when the Hegemony raiders came. A club, a shout, and Wendel "Mole" Kelvincornbr was on the trench floor waiting for the medic. Raider: Ivo Fous of the Hegemony (@le_photographe_fous). Wendel "Mole" Kelvincornbr died in the ward while the orderly was reading him a letter from home. The orderly finished the letter anyway.
The papers say Felix "Doc" Kelvincornbr. The sergeant says he has his older brother's eyes. Wendel "Mole" Kelvincornbr's eyes. Nobody in R-F17 argues.
mount.ain220: Yann "Saint" Ain took the place of a man nobody would talk about. The dugout still had his blanket. He kept it folded.

Yann "Saint" Ain crawled through a gap in the Concord wire and slid into their trench. Oskar Eddie reached for a rifle. Yann "Saint" Ain was faster with the sharpened shovel. (@eduard._.eddie) Blackwater Canal has been won. Yann "Saint" Ain listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
nkmcnamee: Gideon Nkmcnamee arrived on Day 9 as a replacement. The men in Q-F16 had been fighting for 9 days already and looked at his clean boots like a rumour from another world.
From Blackwater Canal the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Gideon Nkmcnamee wrote to a fiancée who wears his ring on a chain that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
noirangelfang: Tobias Noirangelfan arrived with the evening ration party, carrying his mother's thimble and a borrowed greatcoat two sizes too big.
Tobias Noirangelfan is always the first one awake. Today, under fire at Grey Mill, that habit was the only steady thing in S-F15.

Tobias Noirangelfan borrowed a book with three readers already waiting. For once, everyone was impatient about something other than relief. Verdel Ridge has been won. Tobias Noirangelfan listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
Dawn watch. Tobias Noirangelfan put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Edmund Potato, grazed.
Tobias Noirangelfan saw Wendel "Mole" Day freeze up on the fire step at the Drowned Farm. Tobias said nothing, just stood closer. It was enough.

Asked what he wanted after the war, Tobias Noirangelfan said a chair. After some thought: a chair nobody else was sitting on. From Hill 304 the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Tobias Noirangelfan wrote to a teacher who said he would amount to nothing that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
The shelling stopped while Tobias Noirangelfan was counting the seconds between hits. He kept counting anyway, and waited a long time before moving.
Benedikt Jakubwilkuu and Tobias Noirangelfan sat through a quiet hour without finding anything to say. At the change of watch, the next pair was told it had been a good hour.
Tobias Noirangelfan thought about a teacher who said he would amount to nothing on sentry tonight, and the night felt a little shorter.
An empty jam tin became Tobias Noirangelfan's cup. The first drink still tasted of strawberries. He took small sips.

Tobias Noirangelfan was on the dawn watch at S-F15 when the Hegemony raiders came. A club, a shout, and Tobias Noirangelfan was on the trench floor waiting for the medic. Raider: Albin Sem of the Hegemony (@sem0235). Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Tobias Noirangelfan kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.
northerncountryman100: After 9 days of war, T-F3 had a place for everything. On Day 9, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Gideon Northerncoun.
The Hegemony won Blackwater Canal. In T-F3, Gideon Northerncoun listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
paintbusch: Ulrich "Doc" Paintbusch was a tailor in Kesselby until the posters went up. He came to T-S12 with a frozen apple, and within a day the whole squad knew that he shares cigarettes but never smokes.
News of the loss of Blackwater Canal reached T-S12 with the rations. Ulrich "Doc" Paintbusch ate while listening to the revised orders.
smiridisnick: Zeno Smiridisnick reported to R-F15 with a bullet that missed him sewn into his tunic lining. The sergeant pretended not to notice.
Number 82 on the early rolls: Zeno Smiridisnick. The First Wave ribbon arrived with instructions about where to sew it and no needle.
Zeno Smiridisnick spent the afternoon delousing his shirt over a candle. The lice won on points.
News of the loss of Verdel Ridge reached R-F15 with the rations. Zeno Smiridisnick ate while listening to the revised orders.

The new recruit kept closing both eyes to aim. Zeno Smiridisnick spent the afternoon helping until one eye stayed open. Zeno Smiridisnick became a sapper today. He wrote the change in a letter home, then crossed out the explanation and tried again.
Machine-gun fire swept R-F15. Zeno Smiridisnick took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Edmund "Whistle" Es of the Concord (@es31230).

Zeno Smiridisnick spent the day on a stretcher outside the aid post, waiting for a bed to come free. The bearers brought water twice. The Hegemony secured Hill 304. Zeno Smiridisnick helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.

The medics would not give up on Zeno Smiridisnick. On a stretcher in the open, between salvos, they kept him alive and then kept him whole. He returned to R-F15 today. Mail came up the line with a letter for Zeno Smiridisnick. Zeno Smiridisnick read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
A football came over the parapet from the Concord side with Tobias "Smokes" Chris's name scratched on it. Zeno Smiridisnick kicked it back. It did not come again.
Norbert Bucket (Concord) and Zeno Smiridisnick (Hegemony) watched each other through the same loophole at Blackwater Canal for an hour. Neither fired. Neither will explain why.

Zeno Smiridisnick was promised a surprise at supper. It was an extra potato. He accepted the surprise with proper ceremony. Mail came up the line with a letter for Zeno Smiridisnick. Zeno Smiridisnick read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Word came down the line: Blackwater Canal is ours. Zeno Smiridisnick shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
